content: Recurring transactions are a standard, marketed feature in market leaders: Money Manager explicitly markets 'transfer, direct debit and recurrence' for salary/insurance/loans (Play Store listing); Bluecoins has a full Reminders Setup (recurring scheduled transactions) and exports reminders to CSV; Spendee markets alerts and reminders for bills. YNAB has scheduled transactions. Verdict: recurring is common in the category; the project's Copy-entry feature is a manual substitute that covers repeating payments without automation.
